features.name: mom_12_1
features.doc: Return from 12 months to 1 month ago.

features.name: mom_6_1
features.doc: Return from 6 months to 1 month ago.

features.name: high_52w
features.doc: Price relative to its 52-week high.

features.name: fip
features.doc: Frog-in-the-pan: momentum built from many small moves rather than a few jumps.

features.name: ind_mom_6
features.doc: Six-month momentum of the stock's statistical industry.

features.name: ret_1m
features.doc: Return over the last month (short-term reversal).

features.name: ret_1w
features.doc: Return over the last week.

features.name: ind_rel_1m
features.doc: Last-month return minus its industry's (industry-adjusted reversal).

features.name: overnight_1m
features.doc: Sum of overnight (close-to-open) returns over the last month.

features.name: intraday_1m
features.doc: Sum of intraday (open-to-close) returns over the last month.

features.name: vol_3m
features.doc: Realized daily volatility over three months (low-volatility effect).

features.name: beta_1y
features.doc: Market beta over one year (betting-against-beta).

features.name: ivol_3m
features.doc: Idiosyncratic volatility relative to the market.

features.name: max_1m
features.doc: Largest daily return in the last month (lottery demand).

features.name: skew_3m
features.doc: Skewness of daily returns over three months.

features.name: log_dvol
features.doc: Log of average daily dollar volume over a month (size/liquidity).

features.name: amihud_1m
features.doc: Amihud illiquidity: price impact per dollar traded.

features.name: volume_trend
features.doc: Recent month's volume relative to the past year (attention).

features.name: ear
features.doc: Market-adjusted return over the 3 days around the latest earnings release (if within 63 sessions).

features.name: days_since_earn
features.doc: Sessions since the latest earnings release (capped).

features.name: earn_soon
features.doc: Next earnings release is likely within the next ~2 weeks (announcement premium).

features.name: filing_rate_3m
features.doc: Number of SEC filings with market-moving forms in the last 63 sessions.

features.name: gp_assets
features.doc: Gross profit over total assets (profitability).

features.name: asset_growth
features.doc: Year-over-year growth in total assets (investment).

features.name: sales_growth
features.doc: Year-over-year growth in trailing revenue.

features.name: accruals
features.doc: Net income minus operating cash flow, scaled by assets.

features.name: roe
features.doc: Trailing return on equity.

features.name: issuance
features.doc: Year-over-year change in shares outstanding (net issuance).

features.name: sue
features.doc: Standardized unexpected earnings (seasonal random walk).

features.name: earnings_yield
features.doc: Trailing net income over market capitalization.

features.name: book_to_market
features.doc: Book equity over market capitalization.

features.name: sales_to_price
features.doc: Trailing revenue over market capitalization.

features.name: log_mcap
features.doc: Log market capitalization (size).
